items.q: Why is there no such thing as a "dopamine hit"?
items.a: Experience depends on **current baseline vs recent peaks**, not absolute release. After any big peak, baseline drops (tonic vs phasic; depleted vesicle pool). Repeated indulgence raises your enjoyment threshold.

items.q: What is the pleasure-pain balance after a reward?
items.a: Pleasure is followed by sub-perceptible "pain" (craving) because the readily releasable pool is depleted. **Addiction = progressive narrowing** of what still releases dopamine as you chase the peak again.

items.q: Do chocolate, social media, and workouts share one budget?
items.a: Yes — chocolate, alcohol, intense exercise, social media, and sex all draw from the **same dopamine currency** across the week. **Dopamine stacking** silently erodes drive.

items.q: How do intermittent dopamine schedules preserve drive?
items.a: Use **casino-style variable reinforcement** — e.g. flip a coin whether to bring music/pre-workout/phone into the gym. Don't spike before or after effort; spike **from** effort.
Layering dopamine sources dulls the underlying activity. Huberman's personal rule: **no phone in workouts** this year.

items.q: Which stimulant is the exception before hard work?
items.a: Pre-workout drinks, Adderall/Ritalin/modafinil before every session eventually undermine motivation — **caffeine excepted** because it **upregulates D2/D3** receptors; yerba mate may also protect dopamine neurons.

items.q: How much can cold immersion raise dopamine?
items.a: About **14°C** water up to the neck for up to an hour → **~250% above baseline**, sustained ~**3 hours** — comparable peak to cocaine **without the crash**, and can raise baseline long-term.

items.q: How do you get dopamine from effort itself?
items.a: External gold-star rewards reduced intrinsic drawing in a Stanford nursery study. Growth mindset = access dopamine **during friction** via prefrontal reframing: **"this pain is the good part."

items.q: How do you reset highly palatable food sensitivity?
items.a: A **48-hour** abstinence from highly palatable foods can restore taste sensitivity via a dopamine reset.

items.q: Which supplement and light pitfalls matter most?
items.a: Mucuna = intense + crash; **L-tyrosine 500–1000 mg** peaks ~**45 min** then drops; PEA + Alpha-GPC for short focus. Avoid melatonin for sleep (**lowers dopamine ~60 min**) and bright light **10 PM–4 AM** (multi-day suppression).
